summary: Mark Reilly’s internet service dropped last night and has not returned. Sofia initiated troubleshooting by checking for an outage in his area; she confirmed a line fault and scheduled a technician visit tomorrow morning with no charge. The client was offered a temporary mobile hotspot data allowance to mitigate the downtime until the issue is resolved.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed Mark by his name, using “Hi Mark.”

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged Mark’s frustration with the internet outage ("I'm sorry about that...") and validated his concern.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions and using respectful language. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated Mark’s issue in their own words (“Can you tell me…?”) to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Mark's name and account details before proceeding.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked probing questions about the router lights to understand the root cause of the problem.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly explained the next steps (technician visit, hotspot backup, credit).

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent successfully resolved the issue by booking a technician and providing a temporary data allowance.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Mark’s concerns without interrupting or becoming defensive.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the issue was resolved ("Done, I've added a temporary allowance...") and offered further assistance before closing.
